items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: Well, the records show that with Al.

ctx.x: Well, I think they all played very fine. Abbey Brunas played a real good lead swing cornet. Of course, with a more refined sort of tone. Brent Bowman was certainly a real fine driving lead trumpet player at one time. Same as Bill Padron. Bill Padron really played a real fine lead trumpet. In fact, Eddie Miller picked him as his favorite. Eddie Miller was interviewed by a downbeat of Metronome magazine back in 35 or 36, and Eddie Miller picked him as his favorite. lead trumpet player. So, you know, he must have…
Well, the records show that with Al. That's right. Well, Padron and Bowman both come through good. Yeah, that's right.
Of course, Kid Rene and Petit and all those fellows were around at that time too. They were no slouches either. You remember them?
